title_sq: Apartament 1+1 per Shitje tek Komuna e Parisit 162,000 €
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 1+1 tek Komuna e Parisit.
Ne afersi te Kompleksit Kristal (100m ne perendim te Kompleksit Kristal), ne rrugen Robert Zhvarc. Pozicion i pershtatshem duke krijuar mundesin e menjehershme te qarkullimit per ne unazen e vogel edhe qender, si edhe gjithashtu dalje te menjehershme ne unazen e madhe.
Apartamenti eshte i pershtatshem per nje familje ose edhe per ambient biznesi (zyra), duke qene ne nje zone me aktivitete te larmishme biznesesh.
Tarifa e qerase ne kete zone si edhe referuar tipilogjise se ketij apartamenti fillon minimalisht nga 550 dhe eshte ne rritje edhe ne varesi te mobilimit brenda ambienteve.
Pallatit do t'i vihet ashensor se shpejti.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Paris Municipality €162,000
description_en: 1+1 Apartment for sale in Paris Municipality. Near the Crystal Complex (100m west of the Crystal Complex), on Robert Zhvarc street. Suitable position, creating the possibility of immediate traffic for the small ring and center, as well as immediate exit to the big ring. The apartment is suitable for a family or even for a business environment (office), being in an area with diverse business activities. The rent in this area, as well as referring to the typology of this apartment, starts at a minimum of 550 and is increasing depending on the furniture inside the premises. The building will be equipped with an elevator soon.
